items.title: Weather forecast updated as of 28 June 2026 5:27am
items.description:
##Weather##

Issued on Sunday, 28 June 2026 at 5:30am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Detailed forecast##

The last of any rain will quickly clear, leaving the rest of the day generally dry with sunny spells soon developing. Moderate to fresh southwest wind and a maximum temperature of 18°C.

Mostly dry with sunny spells tomorrow. Mainly moderate southwest winds and temperatures of 17 or 18°C at best. Then rain arriving from the west overnight.


##Outlook##

Rain continuing at first on Tuesday, then clearing to scattered showers through the morning. Moderate southerly winds and a top temperature of 18°C.
